dimensions.assessment: Directly affects disabled veterans and members of the Armed Forces eligible for adaptive vehicle assistance from the VA.
dimensions.evidence: certain disabled veterans or members of the Armed Forces

dimensions.assessment: Provides a moderate financial benefit to eligible individuals by covering vehicle delivery costs that were previously excluded.
dimensions.evidence: paying expenses associated with the delivery of such vehicle

dimensions.assessment: Increases VA obligations by including delivery expenses within the full purchase price cap for adaptive vehicles.
dimensions.evidence: by paying the total purchase price of the automobile or other conveyance, and the total shipping price

dimensions.assessment: Makes narrow amendments to title 38 of the United States Code regarding VA vehicle benefits and pension payment limitations.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 38, United States Code, to expand the authority of the Secretary of Veterans Affairs

dimensions.assessment: Provides ongoing coverage for vehicle delivery costs and extends a specific statutory deadline to March 31, 2032.

missing_information: Total estimated federal cost of adding vehicle delivery expenses
Number of veterans annually utilizing the adaptive vehicle program
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the VA to include shipping and delivery costs when purchasing adaptive vehicles for certain disabled veterans and members of the Armed Forces, and extends a limitation on certain pension payments by four months.
